data.long_meaning: Historically derived from Old English 'Gar-rida', meaning 'spear-ride'. Garret has a rich history in Western culture and spirituality. The name Garret carries the meaning “Spear-rider” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Garret usually hope their child will grow to embody spear-rider and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Garret belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spear-rider.”

in_latin.name: Garret
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Garret is derived from the Hebrew name Gerad, meaning lance-bearer or spear carrier. In Christian tradition, Garret is associated with one of King David's mighty men, Gerad son of Aner.

in_english.name: Garret
in_english.meaning: Brave with spear or strong with lance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Garret originates from the Hebrew name Gerad, meaning brave with spear or strong with lance. In the Bible, Garret is associated with one of King David's mighty men. The name signifies strength, bravery, and leadership. In Christian tradition, Garret symbolizes courage and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: Garret is an Anglo-Saxon name that has remained popular throughout the centuries. In feudal Europe, knights and warriors were known to bear names that denoted their martial prowess and skill in battle. The name 'Garret' , meaning 'spear-ride', became a symbol of valor, courage, and the warrior spirit. Today, it continues to represent Strength, valor, and the indomitable spirit of those who carry the name.
data.spiritual_significance: Derived from the Old English 'Gar-rida', meaning 'spear-ride', Garret carries a deeper spiritual significance rooted in the Biblical narrative of becoming a "Warrior for Christ". Garrett! A loud noise from the land, majesty and praise are in the multitude of the people." In this passage, Garrett is depicted as a mighty warrior, whose strength and power come from God, and who brings majesty and praise through the multitude of his people. The name thus inspires a calling to strive for spiritual growth, to be a fierce advocate for truth and righteousness, and to carry out God's will in the world.
